title: Crown Studio | Condo Rental in 30a | 30a Beach Properties – 30A Beach Properties
meta_description: Offering fabulous gulf, western green and sunset views, Crown Studio is a rental you don't want to miss! Click here to learn more and book a stay today.
description_expanded:
30a Beach Properties presents Crown Studio. This 58 Main St Rosemary Beach location offers fabulous gulf, western green and sunset views from a fabulous clean newly furnished condo. This rare south Main St address is steps to restaurants and the beach. A perfect location for easy family beach access or attending a wedding. All new interiors by local professional designer feature soft natural fabrics and crisp clean bedding in a refreshing beach design!

Crown Studio occupies the entire 2nd floor of 58 Main Street. A front balcony overlooks Main Street with views of the Western Green and the Gulf. The rear balcony is a common space and offers an outdoor dining table and a place for your beach gear.

The spacious open floor plan provides a luxurious king sleeping area with fresh linens. All towels, bed linens, blankets, comforters, and pillow/mattress protectors are professionally laundered for every new reservation! The spacious dining area for four and carefully designed living area allows you to comfortably spend time with friends and family. Around the corner in a secluded alcove is a gorgeous queen bed with the finer details considered.

We provide passes to access all 4 Rosemary Beach Community pools, and any of the 9 Beach Walkovers

All towels, bed linens, blankets, comforters, and pillow/mattress protectors are professionally laundered for every new reservation!

Bed 1: King (main room)

Bed 2: Queen (tucked in alcove overlooking main st with privacy curtain to close off from the rest of unit)

Fully equipped kitchenette features coffee, microwave, larger sized toaster oven, dishwasher and full sink. The mini-fridge produces ice cubes. There is a secondary mini fridge in a closet area.

No elevator.

No smoking.

No pets.

Parking is one reserved space directly behind the condo.

The Barbados pool and Coquina Pool (heated) are nearby. Boardwalk 'G' is steps away.

Features

•Fully-equipped kitchenette

•New furnishings, bedding in an upscale look

•Wireless Internet, flat panel TV

•Washer/dryer

•Iron and board

•Two entrances from Main St or West entrance provide easy, clean stair access.

We look forward to hosting you!
